criteria.requirement: Implement werkzeug.problems.problem_response(error,*,type="about:blank",instance=None,extensions=None) for real HTTPException. Create a NEW Response with actual error status, type/title/status/detail and optional instance/extensions, UTF8 finite JSON, application/problem+json and exact content length. Retain original protocol headers including duplicate Set-Cookie, Allow, WWW-Authenticate and Retry-After; replace only representation headers appropriately. Do not mutate a response supplied inside the exception. Reject reserved extension collisions/non-string keys and non-error status. Do not turn unrelated Python exceptions into successful HTTP responses.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
